freeze_statement: Re-freeze after the second PAPER_REVIEW_PROMPT panel pass (review_2026_07_22). Third pass, same day: SE-048 RESOLVED -- MDPI submit-mode line numbering is RESTORED in both documents after testing showed the feared parity breakage does not occur (0 stray line-number tokens on pdftotext extraction, page count unchanged at 40, parity gate green); the deviation record D-2 is updated from 'deferred' to 'resolved'. SE-036 partial -- the 13-step generation pipeline is now a real enumerated list rather than a 106-word semicolon chain, four over-long sentences in the results section are de-packed, and the duplicated rank-biserial definition is consolidated; 70 sentences remain above the 55-word threshold and the full de-packing pass is NOT complete. Fourth pass, same day: SE-034 CLOSED -- reference 27's printed DOI (10.1137/S0036144502428893) 404s at Crossref and at the DOI handle API and is corrected to 10.1137/S003614450242889, and the Holm and Demsar note fields no longer say 'JSTOR record above' / 'URL above' (the MDPI .bst suppresses url, so both dangled in all four artifacts); both notes now carry their identifier inline. SE-022 CORRECTION -- an earlier pass in this session wrongly marked four Phase-3 artifact rows (notation tables, pseudocode, parameter table, equation registry) as having no manuscript label; their labels ARE defined, in the files main.tex \input's, and validate_artifact_labels.py now follows \input recursively (153 labels, 74 checked, all resolve, 0 rows declaring none). SE-036 -- de-packing continued across all five sections: 61 flagged sentences at the corrected baseline, now 48 (37 over 55 words, 18 with two or more semicolons). The pass is NOT complete. Fifth pass, same day: SE-046 CLOSED, and closed WITHOUT any rerun -- both remaining items were mis-scoped as needing new experiments when the data was already in the promoted release. (a) The six-comparator CEC2013 Wilcoxon-Holm matrix (Table SA03, tab:cec2013-pairwise) is now typeset in the supplement, read verbatim from wilcoxon_holm_cec2013_D{10,30,50}.csv; five of the eighteen contrasts are Holm-significant and all five favour DT-GSK. Win/tie/loss columns are omitted because no released CEC2013 artifact records them. (b) The BCa RANK intervals behind T16_bca.tex are now emitted as bca_rank_ci_cec2017.csv (28 rows); they previously existed only inside the typeset table, and the released bca_ci_*.csv files hold a different estimand (intervals on per-function mean DIFFERENCES, not on Friedman mean ranks). (c) generate_t16_bca.py defaulted to the SUPERSEDED rel-2026-07-16-78f075cb0; re-pointed to the promoted release after verifying that BOTH releases reproduce the shipped T16_bca.tex byte-identically, so no printed value moved. SE-034 CLOSED as recorded above. Two new artifact_binding rows (61 total). Sixth pass: SE-036 sentence de-packing COMPLETE for the over-length criterion. From a corrected baseline of 61 flagged sentences (the original 98/70 counts were inflated by a measurement bug that merged sentences across inline % comments), the manuscript now has ZERO sentences above 55 words. introduction.tex, conclusions.tex and related_work.tex are fully clean. Three flags remain, all in performance.tex and all triggered by semicolon count alone: they are parallel NUMERIC items inside parentheses (comparator error values at F26 D100; per-dimension rank/omnibus triples; per-dimension Holm p and W-T-L triples), where the semicolon is a required list separator because the items contain internal spacing. Splitting them was judged to harm readability, and they are recorded as accepted rather than silently counted as fixed. No claim, number, rank, p-value, equation or figure changed. Seventh pass: SE-014 CLOSED (the register's only essential_before_submission item). The author attested SIX full-panel candidate configurations examined during development, including the one promoted. The supplement's Configuration Selection subsection now carries the count with its inclusion criterion ('full panel' = run against all seven algorithms on the full CEC2017 function set) and its exclusions (smoke and debugging runs, partial-function or partial-dimension pilots, single-component ablations and sensitivity checks, failed or incomplete configurations, and post-selection validation / evidence-regeneration runs); the main text carries a one-sentence version pointing to it. PROVENANCE CAVEAT, recorded in decision D-0020 and stated in the manuscript itself: the figure is author-attested and is NOT corroborated by any repository artifact -- a search of papers/governance/ and docs/development/ finds no candidate roster or count -- because the intermediate candidates predate the immutable evidence release and were not retained in it. No number, rank, p-value, statistic, or claim changed; every figure re-renders from the same released data. Main PDF 41 pp (B1=37, within CR-0008's 40-pp cap).
